item.title: Rattle Creek BBQ Food Truck Grand Opening ft. Andrew Wakefield and Friends — Thu Nov 5, 5:00 PM — The Mule at Devils Foot Beverages
item.description:
Rattle Creek BBQ is here to stay! Join us for the grand opening of Rattle Creek BBQ, our new onsite food truck serving up Cali-Mex meets Texas BBQ in the mountains. Owner Mat spent years cooking in Austin, where he fell hard for low-and-slow brisket and bright, fresh flavors. He brought both to Asheville, and the result is a plate that’s rich, smoky, and insanely delicious! Expect BBQ plates, sandwiches, and tacos built around brisket, spare ribs, and pulled pork, with sides like guajillo crunch slaw, elote corn salad, and queso mac & cheese. To celebrate, we’ve got live bluegrass from Andrew Wakefield and friends, free brisket samples while they last, and drink specials all night. Come hungry, bring your friends, and help us give Rattle Creek a proper mountain welcome.
‘The Mule’ – Tasting Room
Say hello to The Mule – a full-service bar/event space in the home of Devil’s Foot Beverage’s production facility. Draft soda, beer, & wine – as well as delicious cocktails & mocktai

item.description:

item.title: New Moon Ceremony — Sun Nov 8, 6:30 PM
item.description:
Awakening Asheville Join us for a gathering to set new intentions and connect with the energy of the new moon. Meet the New Moon in ceremony through astrology, Akashic soul journeying, ritual & embodied intention. Approaching the threshold of a new lunar cycle with intentionality is a powerful choice that becomes even more amplified when done in community.

item.title: New Moon Circle for All with Marian Noble — Sun Nov 8, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Awakening Asheville Join us for a welcoming and inclusive New Moon Circle, where all bodies and all genders are invited into sacred gathering. The New Moon is the seed point of the lunar cycle, a powerful time to pause, reflect, and plant clear intentions for the month ahead.
Our 90-minute circle opens with a grounding meditation to help you arrive fully in body and breath. We'll explore the astrological themes of this New Moon in an accessible way, then move into heart shares, holding space for one another in a supportive, non-judgmental circle. We'll close with a ritual aligned with this month's lunar energy to anchor your intentions.
You'll leave with greater clarity, deeper connection, and inspired momentum for the new lunar cycle. Whether you're new to moon rituals or a longtime practitioner, this circle offers insight, community, and renewal.

item.description:
AVL Digital Nomads **Fewer Prompts, More Focus** AI tools were designed to give us time back. Yet, many of us now spend our days babysitting them. Back-and-forth prompting, copy and pasting, and constantly switching tabs are pulling our attention away from the work that matters most. Join us to explore how proactive AI workflows can free up your time and energy to lock in on your customers, your ideas, and the problems that only you can solve.
**Speaker: [Will Anderson](https://www.linkedin.com/in/will-anderson10/)** Will Anderson is an optimist, creative, and problem solver who helps people understand and navigate the human consequences of technologies like AI. He currently works remotely as an AI Operations Enginner for [Workshop](https://useworkshop.com), where he leads AI enablement and builds internal tooling to allow all of his colleagues to do their best work. Asheville Area A Cappella Singers Whether you are an experienced singer, or just like to sing in your car, come join us as our guest! The Land of The Sky Chorus, located in Asheville, NC, is welcoming guests - men and women - who are interested in joining us in the world-wide community of a cappella singing.
No experience is required; we provide music, voice training and an enjoyable singing experience under expert leadership. Our repertoire of music is fun and spans many styles - most songs are easy to learn and sing. Also, if you’re looking to meet new practice partners or play some matches and you aren’t already in the PlayYourCourt Community, you can go here to see what we’re all about and sign up:
https://www.playyourcourt.com/tennis-community/asheville-nc/meetup/
If you love tennis, we’d love to have you! Be sure and watch the quick video that explains how everything works.
Happy hitting!
- Scott

item.title: The Art of Presence: Meditation and Reflection in the Museum — Sat Dec 5, 9:30 AM — Asheville Art Museum
item.description: Step into the Museum’s galleries before the doors open for a quiet and contemplative morning of meditation, mindful walking, and reflection. This guided experience invites participants to slow down, settle the nervous system, and explore the Museum as a place of sanctuary, spaciousness, and renewal. The session will begin with a brief seated meditation, followed by a walking meditation through selected exhibits. Along the way, participants will pause with gentle mindfulness prompts designed to support personal reflection, embodied awareness, and a deeper connection with the artwork. Rather than offering art historical interpretation, the experience encourages each participant to notice what arises within them through presence, stillness, and mindful seeing. The group will honor noble silence throughout much of the session with occasional opportunities for brief reflection and sharing. No previous meditation experience is needed. Join Joshua on 8/22, 10/3, 11/7, and 12/5. Joshua Cant
